title: The Father in His Greatness
description: The threshold of the inmost. T19 explains why the title "Father" is given at every register where the Lord stands as source: Greatness names the bearing-realm itself, and Father is the standing-one beneath all that stands. The Lord wears the name Father wherever he is foundation — at the inmost, in his calling, in his shining, in the lifting of the natural toward the spiritual. T20 enters: the First Father in his five members of light without measure, his twelve registers of wisdom, with the procession of light, fragrance, voice, greatness, and revelation that goes forth from him into all the states of the soul's formation.
